---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: enhancement
---

# <Issue Title>

## Problem
Clearly describe the current problem, limitation, bug, duplication, performance concern, or UX issue.

Explain:
- where the issue exists
- why it matters
- what negative impact it causes

## Proposed Solution
Describe the intended improvement or refactor.

Include:
- files/components involved
- architectural direction
- expected implementation approach
- example behavior if needed

## Trade-offs
Mention any implementation considerations, limitations, or risks.

Examples:
- added complexity
- potential stale data
- additional memory usage
- required careful testing
- browser compatibility concerns

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Define the expected completed behavior
- [ ] List required implementation outcomes
- [ ] Mention preserved behavior that must remain unchanged
- [ ] Include performance/stability expectations if applicable
- [ ] Include UX/accessibility expectations if applicable
